findings.location: source.html (poem, stanza 5, line 1) — "Creator Spirit, work in me"
findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the mistranslation with a faithful rendering that preserves the theological identity of the phrase and the verb sense. For example: "Roho Muumba, nifanyie kazi" (or "Roho Muumba, nifanye kazi ndani yangu"). Preserve HTML structure exactly (inside the same

element).

findings.location: source.html (poem, stanza 2, line 1-2) — "Divine Redeemer, Thee I bless; / I greet Thy going forth;"
findings.source_quote:
Divine Redeemer, Thee I bless;
I greet Thy going forth;
findings.suggested_fix: Avoid changing "bless" to a stronger term like "abudu" (worship). Use a closer equivalent such as "Ninakubariki" or "Nakupongeza"; render the second line without added sense (do not add "kwa nguvu zako"). Example replacement (preserve HTML): "Mkombozi Mtukufu, Ninakubariki; / Ninakukaribisha ukatoke wako;" or better: "Mkombozi Mtukufu, Ninakubariki; / Ninakaribisha kuja Kwako." Keep capitalization and tag structure as in the translation.
findings.translation_quote:
Mkombozi wa Mbinguni, Ninakuabudu;
Na kukukaribisha ukatoke kwa nguvu zako;

findings.location: source.html (poem, stanza 3, line 4) — "These new births more divine:"
findings.suggested_fix: The translation "Haya uzazi mpya wenye Mungu zaidi:" changes nuance and is awkward. Use a closer phrasing such as "Haya uzazi mpya yaliyo takatifu zaidi:" or "Haya uzazi mpya yaliyo ya kimungu zaidi:" depending on the author's intent. Preserve HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: Haya uzazi mpya wenye Mungu zaidi:

findings.location: source.html (poem, stanza 2, line 3-4) — "I love Thee in the loveliness / Of Thy renewed earth."
findings.source_quote:
I love Thee in the loveliness
Of Thy renewed earth.
findings.suggested_fix: Smooth wording and correct small errors: "Nakupenda Kwako" is awkwardly capitalized and doubled. Suggest: "Nakupenda kwa uzuri / Wa dunia Yako iliyojazwa upya." (Preserve case-sensitivity consistent with style guide.)
findings.translation_quote:
Nakupenda Kwako katika uzuri wake
Wa dunia yako iliyojazwa upya.

findings.location: source.html (poem, stanza 4, line 3) — "This new-born ecstasy of song,"
findings.suggested_fix: The phrase "Hili furaha jipya la wimbo lililozaliwa" is grammatically inconsistent (gender/number and demonstrative). Suggest: "Hii furaha mpya ya wimbo iliyozaliwa" or "Hii ekstasi mpya ya wimbo." Preserve HTML.
findings.translation_quote: Hili furaha jipya la wimbo lililozaliwa,

findings.location: source.html (poem, stanza 6, line 3-4) — "And grant the glad new song to ring / Through the new earth and Heaven."
findings.source_quote:
And grant the glad new song to ring
Through the new earth and Heaven.
findings.suggested_fix: Translation is mostly acceptable but consider smoother phrasing: replace "Na utupatie wimbo wa shangwe mpya uwe ukienea / Kupitia dunia mpya na Mbingu." with "Na utupatie wimbo mpya wa shangwe uwe ukienea / Kupitia dunia mpya nambingu." Also correct spacing/capitalization for "Mbingu" if style requires lower-case. Preserve tags.
findings.translation_quote:
Na utupatie wimbo wa shangwe mpya uwe ukienea
Kupitia dunia mpya na Mbingu.
